cases.description: A sealed rolling poll with a 2-of-3 author panel whose seat 3 sent nothing, beside the 3-of-4 default panel whose seat 4 sent nothing; both author seats approve. The board holds the author transcript, the default transcript and the approvals record, three admitted ballots (a member who joined during the poll at step N0, an opening member at N0 − 1 and tier 2's member in cell 1), an unregistered author seat's share hash, an unregistered default seat's beside it (named first), a ballot without an author half, an author half of the wrong threshold, an author half swapped after proving, a re-vote at N0 + 1 and a byte-identical repeat of the first ballot.
The same election and ballots with no approvals record on the copy: 3.1 is unverifiable with author-approvals-missing, so no key set is registered and no ballot is judged.
Only author seat 1 approves, short of q_A = 2: 3.1 fails with author-approvals, and no ballot is judged.
Every author seat registers and approves: a share hash at author seat 3 is admitted.

The author transcript was made for another definition's author stub (the same poll closing a second later), and the definition and its default run bind it: the author run's check fails 3.1 with ceremony-signature, so no author key set is registered and no ballot is judged.
